description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlementModel class, which represents a data model for leave entitlement information in the OrangeHRM system. It implements the Normalizable interface and uses traits to facilitate serialization and attribute filtering. The model maps properties to an underlying LeaveEntitlement entity and includes OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementModel
classes.description: A data transfer object that serializes LeaveEntitlement data for API responses, including related employee, leave type, and entitlement details with filtering and attribute mapping.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a LeaveEntitlement entity, setting up property filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
